name: librobotraconteur

about.summary: Communication framework for robotics and automation
Communication framework for robotics and automation

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.2.8"

recipe:
  name: robotraconteur-suite
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/robotraconteur/robotraconteur/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: c7bb5c31518b9aaa38ff6f2ff899fda541d8650555976a85e582b06695ad403b
    patches:
      - 470.patch
  - if: linux
    then:
      url: http://www.kernel.org/pub/linux/bluetooth/bluez-5.56.tar.xz
      sha256: 59c4dba9fc8aae2a6a5f8f12f19bc1b0c2dc27355c7ca3123eed3fe6bd7d0b9d
      target_directory: bluez-src

build:
  number: 2

outputs:
  - package:
      name: librobotraconteur
    build:
      script:
        file: build_cpp
      dynamic_linking:
        overlinking_behavior: error
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - if: win
          then: ninja
        - if: unix
          then: make
        - git
        - cmake
        - swig
      host:
        - libboost-devel
        - if: linux
          then:
            - dbus
            - zlib
            - libusb
        - if: unix
          then: openssl
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('librobotraconteur', lower_bound='x.x.x') }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          include:
            - RobotRaconteur.h
          lib:
            - RobotRaconteurCore

  - package:
      name: robotraconteur
    build:
      script:
        file: build_py
      dynamic_linking:
        overlinking_behavior: error
      variant:
        use_keys:
          - python
          - numpy
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - if: win
          then: ninja
        - if: unix
          then: make
        - git
        - cmake
        - swig
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - pip
            - numpy
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('librobotraconteur', exact=True) }}
        - python
        - numpy
        - setuptools
        - libboost-devel
        - pip
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('librobotraconteur', lower_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - python
        - numpy
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('robotraconteur', lower_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - RobotRaconteur
            - RobotRaconteur.Client
          pip_check: false
      - script:
          - python -c "from RobotRaconteur.Client import RRN; print(RRN.RobotRaconteurVersion)"

about:
  homepage: http://robotraconteur.com
  repository: https://github.com/robotraconteur/robotraconteur
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: Communication framework for robotics and automation

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - traversaro
    - johnwason
